title: Assets Manifest
description: Contract between tools/asset-resolver (writer) and the Template Coder Agent (reader). Pins the icon and font records the generated template must consume; the manifest is the single source of truth for asset references.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when asset-resolver wrote this manifest.

revisionDir.description: Repo-relative path to the revision folder this manifest describes.

icons.description: Token → icon record. Keys are stable tokens the Template Coder references in Java.

fonts.description: Role → font record. Keys are stable roles (heading, body, fallback, ...) the Template Coder references in Java.

iconSet.description: Full Iconify identifier (prefix:name) of the picked icon.

prefix.description: Iconify set prefix (mdi, tabler, lucide, entypo-social, ...).

name.description: Iconify icon name within the set.

file.description: Revision-relative path to the rasterised PNG.

size.description: Rasterised pixel size of the PNG.

pointSize.description: Rendering point size the Template Coder should request when laying the icon out. Floats are allowed (e.g. 3.8 for thin rating dots). Optional — when absent, the template falls back to the architecture plan's stated size.

color.description: Hex colour (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA) applied during rasterisation.

pickedBy.description: Why this icon was chosen: explicit user/asset-request pin, preferred-set match (iconify preferredSets list), or broad search fallback. Matches the source values in tools/asset-resolver/src/iconify.mjs.

visualHint.description: Free-form note when pickedBy=visual-hint or for human review.

role.description: Stable role token (heading, body, fallback, code, ...) — matches the architecture plan's font role.

fontName.description: GraphCompose FontName enum constant — uppercase identifier.

source.description: Where the font file comes from.

status.description: Resolution status. manual_drop_required means asset-resolver could not place the file; template-coder must surface it as a Known Limitation.

registration.description: How the Template Coder registers the font in code.
